answer: Each agent identity is registered in tundra, an append-only state tree; onyx is its hash anchor for a zero-knowledge attestation from a TPM-backed SGX enclave, and raven consensus checks measurements and bounded hardware-clock drift. A Sybil attacker must physically provision distinct certified silicon and break enclave isolation or forge TPM signatures; admission uses an O(N^2) bonding curve, while invalid proofs incur irreversible collateral slashing, making expansion superlinear.
